concept.title: About the Concept
concept.lead: An overview of the goal, principles and long-term vision of the Azerbaijani Culture 2040 Concept.
concept.meqsedP1: The Azerbaijani Culture 2040 Concept was prepared to secure the long-term development of national culture, protect cultural heritage and strengthen creative potential. The document defines a single framework for state cultural policy and aligns the strategic directions across all fields.
concept.meqsedP2: The Concept takes into account the cultural needs of society, the protection of national identity in a globalised world and the opportunities created by digital transformation.
concept.prinsiplerP1: The Concept is based on the following principles:
concept.prinsiplerItem1: Protecting national cultural heritage and passing it on to future generations;
concept.prinsiplerItem2: Equal access to culture and regional balance;
concept.prinsiplerItem3: Support for creative freedom and innovation;
concept.baxisP1: By 2040 Azerbaijan should have a sustainable, digital and internationally recognised culture ecosystem. Our cultural heritage should be fully digitised, the creative industries should have become an important part of the economy, and cultural diplomacy should be an inseparable part of the country's international standing.
concept.baxisQuote: Culture is the soul of a nation and the foundation of its future. Protecting and developing it is the duty of each of us.
concept.istiqametlerP1: The Concept is built around eight core areas of activity: improving governance, development of the Azerbaijani language, culture of conduct and knowledge, development of literature, development of the arts, protection of cultural heritage, cultural and creative industries, and cultural diplomacy.
concept.istiqametlerP2: Specific targets, indicators and responsible bodies have been defined for each area.
concept.merhelelerP1: Implementation of the Concept is planned in three phases: 2025–2030 (initial phase — legal framework and institutional reforms), 2030–2035 (middle phase — digitisation and creative industries) and 2035–2040 (final phase — formation of a sustainable ecosystem).
